cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I covered your bins while you were away. Cover is temporary; tonight you take them out. Lid closed, handles facing the road.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours send all the reminders to you now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then correct the contact list. Tell them you're responsible; don't just add your name beneath mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in the group until I learn which bin goes when?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read me tonight's colour from the calendar. Then send 'I'll put that one out.' I am checking your handover, not renewing my appointment.

reason: Use exacting collection and contact corrections to make B take the task, with B request for support converted into an explicit supervised commitment.
